run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time gtn.compose forward and backward passes on linear graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward_score benchmark to time gtn.forward_score forward and backward passes on linear graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for with compose and forward_score
run_parallel_benchmarks_with_batch_size: run all parallel benchmarks by passing a batch size B as a command line argument
review_time_compose_function: review the time_compose function that benchmarks gtn.compose and gtn.backward on paired linear graphs with self loops
